summary: To contribute to ansible-core, fork ansible/ansible, branch from devel, and open a PR to devel; for modules in collections, review the submission checklist, tips, Python 2/3 strategy and testing first.
questions: How do I submit a bug fix to ansible-core?
Which branch should my ansible-core PR target?

answer_card.title: Contribute back to ansible-core
answer_card.answer_md: Fork `ansible/ansible`, create a feature branch from `devel`, and open a PR with your branch as source and `devel` as target. For collection modules, review the submission checklist, programming tips, Python 2/3 strategy and testing guidance first.
